prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
Four concentric expanding wave-rings radiating outward from a center
dot — symbolic of social resonance.
formatted_prompt: Flat app icon on off-white canvas (#E7E3D5), generous padding, centered composition. Four concentric arc-rings radiating outward from a solid central dot, each ring progressively thinner and lighter, rendered as bold flat vector shapes with crisp sharp edges. Central dot in deep burnt sienna (#D97742), inner ring in warm terracotta, middle rings stepping through muted clay and dusty amber (#C9A96B), outermost ring in pale sand fading toward the background. All shapes use solid flat fills, zero gradients, zero texture, zero brushwork. Silhouette reads as a clean signal-pulse or sonar icon. Geometry is precise and deliberate, every arc perfectly concentric, gap spacing even and intentional. Fully legible at 16px. Dark near-black (#0B0F14) reserved for maximum-contrast moments only. Modern UI icon register, 2026-era app design.
